$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-opencorporates-source). Seeds the pre-built `opencorporates` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister OpenCorporates company-search integration leaf (OpenCorporatesProvider SOURCE_ID='opencorporates'). MOCK MODE (integration-mock-mode): ships with `configuration.mock:true` + a realistic `configuration.mockResponse` (OpenCorporates `/companies/search` shape) and isEnabled:true, so the leaf is demonstrably functional end-to-end WITHOUT an OpenCorporates API token — the OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter short-circuits the mock-flagged source and returns the canned body without any HTTP call. To go live: set your OpenCorporates API token on `configuration.query.api_token` (the API authenticates via an `api_token` query parameter) and REMOVE `configuration.mock` (the production base URL `location` is already the real OpenCorporates v0.4 endpoint). No end-user input reaches the request URL, so there is no SSRF surface (the base URL is admin-owned on the source).
